_comment: Qoder usage reply, GET openapi.qoder.sh/api/v2/quota/usage (task 035). The live wire, measured 2026-11-12 (plan's Э9): a FLAT camelCase object, no envelope; totalUsagePercentage is a FRACTION 0..1 (the inner percentage fields of userQuota/addOnQuota are fractions too), expiresAt is epoch MILLISECONDS. One quota row: the SUM against the plan's month. userQuota, addOnQuota and dedicatedResourcePackages are deliberately absent -- no package breakdown (the owner's word, 2026-11-12). A refusal is a reply carrying code != 0 (not this shape). Only read by the reference tool in --offline mode when a Qoder login is present.
